newsitem.title: USA: Murdoch unit buying International Family.
newsitem.headline: Murdoch unit buying International Family.

text.p: International Family Entertainment Inc., the media company owned by Christian evengelist and political commentator Pat Robertson, said Wednesday it is being bought by a unit of Rupert Murdoch's News Corp.

News Corp.'s Fox Kids Worldwide Inc. unit, the children's programming arm of Murdoch's media empire, will pay $35 a share in cash for IFE, which owns The Family Channel cable network. IFE will be the surviving company, the two companies said.
Pat Robertson and Tim Robertson, as well as Regent University and the Christian Broadcasting Network Inc., have agreed to sell all their shares under separate agreements.
Stockholders holding a majority of the voting power of International Family have given consents to the deal.
Fox Kids, which is owned equally by News Corp and Saban Entertainment, aims to expand International Family through News Corp's worldwide distribution system.
